node.title: Bridge 2: juntas = fixed-core families = tangent/common-divisor structures = PAID
node.statement: A junta on J(n,j) (membership determined by a bounded core C of domain points) is a union of fixed-core/fixed-hole cells; correlation with a junta transfers to correlation with common-divisor (tangent-type, depth |C|) structure — landing exactly in the paid taxonomy. The k=1 dictator extremals (#191, proved) are the base case.
node.notes: PACKET WRITTEN (wave 1, same note): <= 2^d cell decomposition, exact divisor/avoidance characterization, factorization onto the complementary instance, 2^-d pigeonhole transfer.
